summary: postgres ran out of connections at 14:02:05 IST and every other failing service was waiting on it. Login, ledger and payment failures are downstream effects, not separate problems.

sentences.text: postgres connection pool reached 100% at 14:02:05 IST and began refusing new clients.
About 1.1 s later auth-svc logins started failing because auth-svc could not acquire a database connection.
ledger-svc writes then timed out waiting on the same pool, pushing its error rate to 0.42.
payments-svc failed because ledger-svc returned 503, so failed payments are a symptom of the database problem.
api-gateway p95 latency rose to 3120 ms as requests queued behind both failing paths.
57 users saw a failed login or payment and 38 payments worth INR 45462 failed.
